label: 24-port LC/UPC fibre patch panel / ODF, 1U
description: 1U rack-mount optical distribution frame holding 12 x LC/UPC duplex adapters (24 fibres), used to terminate outside-plant cable and cross-connect it to the equipment side. Passive pass-through: <=0.2 dB insertion loss per mated LC/UPC pair (0.1 dB typical), >=50 dB return loss, ceramic split sleeves; the enclosure takes four such panels for 96 fibres in 1U.
formFactor: 1U 19-inch FHD enclosure, 12 x LC duplex adapter panel
notes: 1U 19-inch FHD enclosure with a 12 x LC/UPC duplex adapter panel = 24 fibres. Passive: <=0.2 dB insertion loss per mated LC/UPC pair (0.1 dB typical), >=50 dB return loss, ceramic split sleeves, four panels fit one FHD enclosure for 96 fibres. Modelled with 'pairPrefix: rear', so each front fibre port is joined to its rear partner and a run can cross the ODF (host -> port N -> rear N -> host) instead of terminating on it; without the pairing this device was a dead end that looked cabled. Not an optical amplifier and not a splitter - a mated pair is one junction, so it adds loss and nothing else.
